verdicts.reason: A: the steps are broken up (01 sits above the eyebrow, 02 and 03 are below the bag), the step copy is far too small to read, and the legal line is set larger than the steps and wedged between 02 and 03. Its numbering does still run 01-02-03, and the logo stays with the CTA. B has the same tiny unreadable step text and legal copy bigger than the steps, and is worse because the steps run out of order (01, then 03 above the bag, then 02 below it), which breaks the reading sequence.
